zombies.name: Walker
zombies.manual: Slow and weak, but comes in big numbers. Rifle squads and machine guns handle them.

zombies.name: Runner
zombies.manual: Fast and weak. Punishes gaps in your coverage. Machine guns slow them down.

zombies.name: Crawler
zombies.manual: Drags itself along the ground and is hard to spot: positions only see it at two thirds of their range. Snipers reach it first.

zombies.name: Screamer
zombies.manual: Its shrieks drive the horde: zombies close to it on the road move a third faster. Kill it first, ideally with a sniper.

zombies.name: Bloater
zombies.manual: Swollen and slow, with a lot of health. If it reaches the Command Post it bursts and does three times the damage.

zombies.name: Armored
zombies.manual: Infected soldiers in body armor. Armor takes 6 off every hit, so rifles and light machine guns barely scratch them. Snipers and heavy guns punch through.

zombies.name: Brute
zombies.manual: A huge, slow mutant that soaks up fire, with armor that takes 4 off every hit. Boss of every tenth round. Breaks through for 6 damage.

zombies.name: Behemoth
zombies.manual: The final boss. Enormous, armored (takes 10 off every hit) and almost unstoppable. If it reaches the Command Post, the line falls. Focus everything on it.
